what: Cost of a bounded neighbourhood extraction on the national snapshot, against the 5 s interactive ceiling.
supersedes: An earlier run of this file measured a copy that carried NO arc_transitions, NO physical_access_* and national component_id labels. That copy answered from a different model rather than a smaller one, so its timings were not comparable and are withdrawn rather than carried forward. The figures below are for a copy with every derived structure rebuilt.

spotCheck.note: Rebuilding roughly doubles a copy of this size, and it is still an order of magnitude inside the budget.

derivedRebuildIsIncluded.howNotWhether: arc_transitions are REBUILT by build_arc_transitions over the arcs present; nodes.component_id is RECOMPUTED over the copy's own links; physical_access_* is REBUILT. None is copied. A derived structure copied from a larger network describes that larger network.

evidenceThatCopyingComponentsWasWrong.note: The labels genuinely differ. routing._same_component uses component_id to decide whether to search at all, so the copied labels were describing connectivity the fragment does not contain.

verdict: OK at p95 - 0.65 s against a 5 s ceiling, with derived structures rebuilt.
whatThisStillDoesNotMeasure: This is EXTRACTION ONLY and must not be quoted as user-facing response time. Not measured here: the canonical analysis, candidate retrieval and ranking, the validation pass, a single counterfactual route, the total across all candidates, cleanup, or the full API request. Those are separate figures and none of them exists yet.
